messages:
lisa: FYI we started getting SCIM duplicate creates after the idp metadata bundle change for tenant-acme. seeing "assertion bundle mismatch" in service logs.
ben: can you paste the exact log line?
lisa: `ERROR saml: assertion_bundle_mismatch id=acct-42 expected_issuer=urn:okta:org:old got_issuer=urn:okta:org:new NameIDFormat=emailAddress`
eli: that sounds like the federation metadata contained two `<md:EntityDescriptor>` entries and our parser picked a different default issuer after the rotate. happened during last night's metadata swap?
andrew: timeline: okta-bot uploaded metadata 2026-03-19T22:14Z, then our metadata-fetcher ran and cached new bundle. some SP sessions still had old NameID format stored in KV so provisioning lambda sees two different IDs -> dup create.
lisa: reproduction steps I ran: repro on staging by uploading dual-entity metadata, then create user in Okta -> provisioning lambda receives two SCIM create events within 1-3s with different externalId values.
oncall: paging SSO oncall to triage.
okta-bot: metadata-upload success for org-acme (org id 2034) at 2026-03-19T22:14:03Z.
ben: any signature/KMS errors? could be a verification fallback that causes re-issuance.
eli: checked KMS logs: no decrypt/signature errors. Signatures validate for both issuers. It's strictly an issuer/NameID-format mismatch.
lisa: in our SCIM audit we see two separate users created: one with `NameID=email` and another `NameID:transient`. Both map to same email but different externalId hash.
andrew: mitigation idea: temporary dedupe step in provisioning: if new SCIM create shares email with a recent create (<60s), mark as potential duplicate and call our reconcile job instead of creating another account. low-risk and quick.
ben: also add strict-nameid-matching flag to the SSO auth middleware so we ignore assertions with unexpected NameIDFormat for a short window while we roll fixes.
eli: I can push the dedupe + feature flag to staging EU in ~20m and then rollout to prod if green.
lisa: I pushed an alert rule: `sso.dup_provision.count > 1 for 5m` -> pager to oncall. runbook note: fallback steps, how to merge dup accounts, and how to contact idp vendor.
andrew: assign @eli to the hotfix; @lisa to run replay on the backfill reconciliation for affected tenants. I'll own postmortem.
ben: small patch diff to add to provisioning lambda snippet:```python
# quick dedupe
existing = scim_find_by_email(email)
if existing and (now - existing.created_at) < 60:
    tag = 'sso:dup-provision'
    publish_audit(tag, details)
    return reconcile(existing, incoming)
```
eli: deploying to staging now. will enable strict-nameid-matching flag after deploy.
lisa: created a short support template to reach out to tenant's IdP admin with required meta fields to canonicalize NameID format.
andrew: follow-up: scheduled postmortem and vendor escalations. also we'll add parser safety to metadata-fetcher to prefer explicit `md:RoleDescriptor` with `SPSSODescriptor` matching our SP entityID.
lisa: thanks all. moving to follow-up lane. :thumbsup:
